key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP](Disk 1 of 2).adf:library:0:2F68
name: load_channel_sequence_pointer
description: Looks up a sequence start pointer from a table indexed by the channel's current position, stores it as the active sequence pointer, and clears the position and step counter. It is the reset run when a channel begins a new sequence.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP](Disk 1 of 2).adf:library:0:2F8A
name: step_channel_two_sequence
description: Advances the second channel's note sequence: when the step counter is zero it reads the next command word, otherwise it counts down and applies pitch and volume slides before writing the value out. The register notes name the second channel's location register.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP](Disk 1 of 2).adf:library:0:2FA0
name: step_channel_two_sequence_alt
description: Runs the same sequence stepping as the previous routine on a different set of channel state fields, applying slides and writing the resulting value. The reads and writes follow the same command, counter and slide logic.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP](Disk 1 of 2).adf:library:0:2FFC
name: step_sequence_channel_state_b
description: Steps a channel's command sequence, reading the next word when the counter reaches zero and otherwise applying slide and envelope changes. The code writes the result to the channel output and sample state with no register writes shown in the facts.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP](Disk 1 of 2).adf:library:0:3008
name: reset_sequence_from_table_entry
description: Copies a sequence start pointer from a table selected by the current channel index, then clears the index and the step counter. It is the same reset as the first channel's routine, applied to another channel's state.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP](Disk 1 of 2).adf:library:0:302A
name: step_channel_three_sequence
description: Advances the third channel's note sequence, reading the next command when the step counter reaches zero and otherwise applying slide and envelope adjustments. The register notes name the third channel's location register.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP](Disk 1 of 2).adf:library:0:303E
name: step_sequence_and_enable_dma
description: Steps a channel's note sequence, applying slide and envelope changes and writing the resulting value out. The register notes say the DMA control register is written with the enable bit, so this routine also switches audio DMA on as the sequence advances.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP](Disk 1 of 2).adf:library:0:3220
name: init_channel_from_sequence_record
description: Copies initial step and length fields from an incoming sequence record into the channel state, points the channel at its data, and fetches the first value. It is entered through a handler pointer stored in the data table.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP](Disk 1 of 2).adf:library:0:32A0
name: init_channel_from_sequence_header
description: Reads a sequence header word, returns at once if it is the end marker, and otherwise loads the channel's length, data pointer and envelope fields before fetching the first value. It is called through a handler pointer in the data table.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP](Disk 1 of 2).adf:library:0:32A6
name: init_channel_clearing_status_bit
description: Clears bit one of a status byte and then runs the same sequence header setup as the previous routine. The register notes say that status byte holds joystick fire and disk status, so this routine clears a status flag before starting a channel.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP](Disk 1 of 2).adf:library:0:32B2
name: set_status_bit_init_channel
description: Sets bit one of the status byte, which the register notes tie to joystick fire and disk status, then runs the standard sequence header setup on the channel. It is the setting counterpart of the routine that clears that same bit.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP](Disk 1 of 2).adf:library:0:32BE
name: init_channel_from_optional_table
description: Reads a table header and, if its first word is zero, copies a single record into the channel's fields; otherwise it copies three longword groups. It then runs the standard sequence header setup from the following data.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP](Disk 1 of 2).adf:library:0:32D4
name: init_channel_from_parameter_block
description: Copies three longword groups from a parameter block into the channel fields and then runs the standard sequence header setup. The parameter block is read through a pointer held in a register, not from the record itself.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP](Disk 1 of 2).adf:library:0:32E8
name: init_channel_from_pointer_list
description: Advances through a list of indirect pointers stored in the channel, wrapping to the base entry when the current entry is zero, then reads the sequence header from the selected pointer and sets up the channel. It is called through a handler pointer in the data table.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP](Disk 1 of 2).adf:library:0:3300
name: init_channel_with_base_pointer
description: Stores a longword from the incoming record as the channel's base pointer, advances the stored pointer, and runs the standard sequence header setup from the following data. It is entered through a handler pointer in the data table.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP](Disk 1 of 2).adf:library:0:330E
name: init_channel_from_long_pair
description: Copies two longwords from the incoming record into the channel's data fields, then runs the standard sequence header setup from the record that follows them.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP](Disk 1 of 2).adf:library:0:331A
name: init_channel_with_three_longs
description: Sets the channel's enable flag, copies three longwords from the incoming record into the channel's pointer fields, and then runs the standard sequence header setup from the following data.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP](Disk 1 of 2).adf:library:0:3330
name: reset_channel_then_init_sequence
description: Clears the channel's secondary counter field and then runs the standard sequence header setup from the incoming record. The reset happens before the header is read.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP](Disk 1 of 2).adf:library:0:3338
name: clear_channel_flag_and_init
description: Clears the channel's active flag and then runs the standard sequence header setup from the incoming record, so the channel starts from a cleared state.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP](Disk 1 of 2).adf:library:0:3340
name: clear_per_command_state
description: Branches on the channel's current command value: command six clears one byte of sound state, command five clears a longword, command seven clears another byte, and any other command clears a separate state variable. In every case it sets the global value to one and clears the channel's secondary field.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP](Disk 1 of 2).adf:library:0:3352
name: reset_channel_zero_output
description: Writes a value to the channel's output, clears the channel's flag field, and clears a shared sound flag. The register notes name the channel-zero period and DMA control registers, but the displayed code writes only the channel state.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP](Disk 1 of 2).adf:library:0:336E
name: reset_channel_one_output
description: Writes a value to the channel's output, clears the channel's flag field, and clears a shared sound flag for the second channel. The register notes name the channel-one period and DMA control registers, which this code does not write directly.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP](Disk 1 of 2).adf:library:0:338A
name: reset_channel_two_output
description: Writes a value to the channel's output, clears the channel's flag field, and clears a per-channel state byte for the third channel. The register notes name the channel-two period and DMA control registers, which this code does not write directly.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP](Disk 1 of 2).adf:library:0:33A6
name: reset_channel_three_output
description: Writes a value to the channel's output, clears the channel's flag field, and clears a shared sound flag for the fourth channel. The register notes name the channel-three period and DMA control registers, which this code does not write directly.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP](Disk 1 of 2).adf:library:0:33C2
name: init_channel_with_offset_flag
description: Sets the channel's offset-enable field to one and then runs the standard sequence header setup from the incoming record. Once set, later steps add the channel's offset value to each fetched command.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP](Disk 1 of 2).adf:library:0:33CC
name: init_channel_from_pointer_slot
description: Loads the channel's current record pointer from a fixed slot, advances the slot, and runs the standard sequence header setup from the record it points to. It is entered through a handler pointer in the data table.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP](Disk 1 of 2).adf:library:0:61E8
name: decode_packed_palette_and_rows
description: Expands thirty-two packed palette entries of three bytes each into a table of 12-bit colour values, then decodes run-length encoded rows of 320 bytes using marker bytes for repeats. The register notes name the background colour register, and the listing is cut off partway through the per-frame table lookups.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP](Disk 1 of 2).adf:library:0:8910
name: decode_bitstream_symbol_table
description: Pulls bits from the packed input into an accumulator, walks a symbol table to decode one value, and writes it to the output. When a table counter passes its mask, the mask is doubled, so the table widens as decoding proceeds.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP](Disk 1 of 2).adf:library:0:899A
name: init_adaptive_decoder_tables
description: Fills one table with minus-one longwords and another with zero longwords, writes a descending byte sequence from 255 to zero, and sets the decoder's counter to nine and its mask to 511. It prepares the tables used by the bitstream symbol decoder.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP](Disk 1 of 2).adf:library:0:8C74
name: poll_status_until_timeout
description: Calls two indirect routines from a dispatch table, then loops calling them and checking a status flag until the flag is set or a countdown reaches zero. It then runs one or two more indirect routines and returns the status value. The layout is repeated in its neighbours.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP](Disk 1 of 2).adf:library:0:AC74
name: poll_status_until_timeout
description: Runs the same status polling sequence as its neighbour: indirect dispatch calls, a countdown of ten thousand iterations, and a status flag check. It returns the status value after the cleanup calls.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP](Disk 1 of 2).adf:library:0:B484
name: enter_status_polling_body
description: A one-instruction entry in the facts, whose displayed pseudo-code is the shared status polling body used by its neighbours. It calls the dispatch routines, polls the status flag, and returns the status value.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP](Disk 1 of 2).adf:library:0:B488
name: poll_status_handler_entry
description: Its two-instruction entry is reached through a handler pointer, and the listing shown is the same status polling body as its neighbours. That body calls dispatch routines, counts down a timeout and checks a status flag.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP](Disk 1 of 2).adf:frontend:0:0000
name: stub_program_entry_polling
description: The facts list a single instruction at the program entry, and the listing shown is the shared status polling body. No separate behaviour can be confirmed for this entry beyond calling that body.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP](Disk 1 of 2).adf:frontend:0:0006
name: stub_absolute_compare_no_effect
description: Takes absolute values of two signed inputs and compares them, but both branches return without storing a result, so the routine has no visible effect.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP](Disk 1 of 2).adf:frontend:0:0036
name: search_nearest_grid_match
description: Looks up grid cells around an input position through several nested tables, sums distance terms to each candidate entry and keeps the smallest, starting from the largest signed value. The listing is cut off before the search finishes.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP](Disk 1 of 2).adf:frontend:0:0454
name: dispatch_offset_then_restore
description: Sets a flag byte from one register and offsets two coordinate words by one, calls a dispatch routine through a fixed slot, then restores the flag and the original coordinates and calls the dispatch routine again. The same pattern appears in each of its neighbouring entries.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP](Disk 1 of 2).adf:frontend:0:0458
name: dispatch_offset_then_restore
description: Offsets the stored coordinates by one, calls the dispatch routine through its slot, then restores the original values and calls it a second time. Its code is identical to the neighbouring offset-and-restore entries.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP](Disk 1 of 2).adf:frontend:0:045C
name: dispatch_offset_then_restore
description: Repeats the offset, dispatch, restore and second dispatch sequence used by its neighbours, with the flag byte taken from the other input register. The coordinate words are restored before the second call.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP](Disk 1 of 2).adf:frontend:0:0460
name: dispatch_offset_then_restore
description: Sets a flag byte and offsets two coordinate words by one, calls a dispatch routine, then restores the coordinates and flag and dispatches again. It matches the other single-instruction entries in the same group.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP](Disk 1 of 2).adf:frontend:0:0464
name: dispatch_offset_then_restore
description: Runs the same offset, dispatch and restore sequence as its neighbours, with the coordinate words taken from the input registers. The second dispatch call uses the restored values.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP](Disk 1 of 2).adf:frontend:0:0474
name: dispatch_offset_then_restore
description: Offsets a coordinate pair by one, calls the dispatch routine, restores the pair and the flag byte, and calls dispatch again. The facts count thirteen instructions for this entry, and the pseudo-code shows the same sequence.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP](Disk 1 of 2).adf:frontend:0:04A4
name: copy_null_terminated_bytes
description: Copies bytes from a source pointer into a fixed destination buffer one at a time, stopping after it copies a zero byte. The zero terminator is copied too.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP](Disk 1 of 2).adf:frontend:0:04B2
name: append_null_terminated_string
description: Walks the destination buffer to its terminating zero, then copies the source bytes there up to and including the source's own zero terminator.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP](Disk 1 of 2).adf:frontend:0:04C6
name: format_signed_number_to_text
description: Converts a signed sixteen-bit value to decimal digits, writes a minus sign for negatives and a comma after the thousands group, and appends the text to the output buffer.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP](Disk 1 of 2).adf:frontend:0:0554
name: format_three_digit_value
description: Writes the hundreds, tens and units of a value as three ASCII digits into a scratch area, terminates them, and appends the text to the output buffer. The code loads a table entry before writing the digits.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP](Disk 1 of 2).adf:frontend:0:0598
name: format_number_with_thousands_commas
description: Converts a signed value to decimal digits by repeated subtraction against a table of powers of ten, inserts a comma after each group of three digits, and appends the text to the output buffer. A negative value gets a leading minus sign.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP](Disk 1 of 2).adf:frontend:0:05D2
name: stub_bad_instruction_data
description: The listing reduces to one word store followed by a bad-instruction marker, so it is bad data rather than a routine. No behaviour beyond that store can be confirmed from the evidence.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP](Disk 1 of 2).adf:frontend:0:0974
name: poll_status_until_timeout
description: Calls dispatch routines from a table, counts down a timeout of ten thousand iterations, and checks a status flag each pass. It returns the status value once the flag is set or the countdown ends.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP](Disk 1 of 2).adf:frontend:0:09D8
name: poll_status_until_timeout
description: Runs the same dispatch, countdown and status flag check as its neighbours and returns the status value. The listing shown is the shared body, so the entry-specific setup cannot be confirmed.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP](Disk 1 of 2).adf:frontend:0:09E4
name: poll_status_until_timeout
description: The facts count about sixteen hundred instructions for this entry, but the listing shown is the shared status polling body. Only that body's dispatch, countdown and status check behaviour is confirmed.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP](Disk 1 of 2).adf:frontend:0:2380
name: poll_status_with_sprite_registers
description: The listing is the shared status polling body, which calls dispatch routines and checks a status flag until a countdown ends. The register notes list sprite pointer and beam position registers, which the displayed listing does not write directly.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP](Disk 1 of 2).adf:frontend:0:247A
name: relocate_pointer_table_entries
description: Walks a table of longword offsets and adds the data area's base address to each entry, counting down through a count held in a variable. Several callers use it to rebase pointer tables.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP](Disk 1 of 2).adf:frontend:0:2486
name: relocate_pointer_table_entries
description: Adds the data area's base address to each longword in a counted table, working down from the count to zero. The callers use it to convert stored offsets into usable pointers.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP](Disk 1 of 2).adf:frontend:0:249A
name: copy_rectangle_with_blitter
description: Waits for the blitter to go idle, sets its first- and last-word masks to all ones, and programs source, destination, modulo, control and size registers for a rectangle copy. It runs the same setup again if the helper call returns zero, and the code takes its screen fields from a structure.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP](Disk 1 of 2).adf:frontend:0:271A
name: advance_object_list_positions
description: Reads a list of object entries, adds each entry's velocity to its stored position across repeated passes, and calls helpers for each object. It returns zero when it reaches an entry whose first value is negative.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP](Disk 1 of 2).adf:frontend:0:286E
name: program_blitter_copy_registers
description: Calls a helper, saves a pointer, waits for the blitter to free up, and programs its masks, modulo, source, destination, control and size registers for a copy. The surface pointer is taken from the calling record.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP](Disk 1 of 2).adf:frontend:0:3D36
name: run_blitter_redraw_loop
description: Programs the blitter with a fixed control word and runs a loop that calls redraw helpers and reprograms the blitter each pass, until a countdown reaches zero. The register notes list the blitter and DMA status registers it polls.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP](Disk 1 of 2).adf:frontend:0:3EE6
name: stub_gap_decoded_as_code
description: The facts say this entry is an unreached gap that decodes as two instructions, and the listing shows part of a shared loop that checks object flags and calls helpers. It is not a clear routine on its own.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP](Disk 1 of 2).adf:frontend:0:3EEC
name: run_state_flag_loop
description: Sets mask bits on two state fields, then repeatedly calls a helper and checks a set of object state flags. It returns when a countdown reaches zero or the flags clear.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP](Disk 1 of 2).adf:frontend:0:4092
name: copy_record_into_state_buffer
description: Selects a thirty-four byte record by index, copies its header fields and a twenty-two byte block into a state buffer, and calls two routines. The text reference in the facts is not used by the listing.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP](Disk 1 of 2).adf:frontend:0:414A
name: call_helper_for_each_row
description: Loops eight times, stepping a pointer by thirty-four bytes per row and calling a helper with the row index and the pointer each time.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP](Disk 1 of 2).adf:frontend:0:4186
name: draw_masked_cell_row
description: Reads a bit mask from a record and, for each set bit from seven down to zero, calls a draw helper at a column that advances by a width taken from a table. The column start is derived from the summed table counts.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP](Disk 1 of 2).adf:frontend:0:4274
name: dispatch_flagged_helper_passes
description: Calls a helper three times: once with a zero flag and no position arguments, then twice with the position arguments, the second time with a flag of thirty-one. The second position is offset by one hundred and sixty units.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP](Disk 1 of 2).adf:frontend:0:42F8
name: fade_palette_components_down
description: Runs six passes over a palette table, reducing each entry's red, green and blue components one step toward zero, and copies the results into a second table. It then sets a fixed value and returns the blue component of the last entry. The register notes name the background colour register, which the listing does not write directly.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP](Disk 1 of 2).adf:frontend:0:4348
name: setup_blitter_masked_tile
description: Computes a source address from the row and column, waits for the blitter, and programs its masks, modulo, source, destination, control and size registers for a masked tile copy. The width comes from the surface record.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP](Disk 1 of 2).adf:frontend:0:43CE
name: insert_ranked_record_entry
